description: Top AWS products by Cost Explorer SERVICE grouping unblended spend over the last N days. Do not add this total to LINKED_ACCOUNT — same dollars, different grain. SERVICE can be incomplete vs linked.

configuration.query:
FROM metrics-aws.billing-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= NOW() - TO_DATEPERIOD(CONCAT(TO_STRING(?days), " days"))
    AND aws.billing.group_definition.key == "SERVICE"
| STATS spend = SUM(aws.billing.UnblendedCost.amount) BY aws.billing.group_by.SERVICE
| SORT spend DESC
| LIMIT 12
